boot.offline: The Reframe server cannot be reached
boot.offlineDetail: Check that the server is running. Reframe tries again on its own.

login.title: Sign in to Reframe
login.tokenIntro: This server wants its access token. It is part of the address the server printed when it started (after #token=).
login.passwordIntro: This server is protected by a password.
login.wrongToken: The server does not accept this token.

firstRun.title: FFmpeg cannot be used
firstRun.welcomeIntro: Reframe runs these programs to read and encode videos. To use other ones, set their paths in Settings → Tools.
firstRun.intro: Reframe needs FFmpeg and FFprobe to read and encode videos. Until they work, the workspace is not available; presets and settings can still be used.

origin.settings: From a path in the settings

firstRun.envNote: The server's environment sets the path ({variables}), and that wins over Settings and a bundled build: change or unset it there, then restart the server.
firstRun.webNote: In a browser, Reframe cannot choose the programs the server runs: download a build or install one from a file, or set {variables} on the server and restart it.
firstRun.unchanged: Checked again at {time}: nothing has changed.
firstRun.buildsIntro: Download a build that Reframe is tested with, or install one from an archive file.

workspace.emptyText: Choose one or more video files. Reframe reads their tracks, and you choose what to keep.

queue.addedAll: {n} job added to the queue | {n} jobs added to the queue
queue.addFailed: The job was added as failed
queue.notAdded: {n} source was not added | {n} sources were not added
queue.stillChecking: its settings are still being checked
